sentences.text: Corynebacterium is a genus of Gram-positive, catalase-positive rod-shaped bacteria with high genomic G+C content, historically grouped with the coryneform bacteria or diphtheroids.
Several species are dominant members of the human skin microbiota, and others are common residents of the normal nasal cavity.
Coryneform bacteria have increasingly been implicated as causes of significant infections, and Corynebacterium jeikeium is reported as a multidrug-resistant nosocomial pathogen of human skin.
